title: Ethics-by-Design Complex Networks — License Friction and Epistemic Boundaries
scope: Govern the relations among license surfaces, ethics-by-design, complex-network edges, TOKEN_VAZIO/INCERTEZA states, parable references, and anti-regression evidence without making legal or scientific claims.

limitations: No legal enforceability determination is made.
External File Library sources are not repository-hash-bound in this module.
Metaphor and parable are didactic layers and cannot satisfy evidence gates.
A machine-readable canonical license expression remains TOKEN_VAZIO pending explicit legal/editorial decision.

data_governance.retention: append-only successor records; negative evidence preserved
data_governance.update_policy: never overwrite historical uncertainty; close only with receipt-bound successor
data_governance.legal_applicability: TOKEN_VAZIO_LEGAL_REVIEW; this module classifies repository surfaces but does not decide enforceability

security.secrets: No secrets required; repository-local read-only validation.
security.incident_record: Any attempted auto-promotion of legal/scientific state is recorded as anti-regression failure.

acceptance_criteria: legal, symbolic, provenance and ethics layers remain distinct
every P0/P1 entry has providencia and falsifier
parables reference an operational subject without serving as evidence
rejection_criteria: MIT metadata is silently treated as equivalent to LICENSE.md
symbolic language is interpreted as executable legal sanction
external source is represented as repository-hash-bound without a hash
promise is treated as proof or runtime guarantee
quality.change_control: PR-reviewed, hash-bound, fail-closed; no automatic LICENSE rewrite.

rollback.trigger: validator/test regression or any automatic legal/scientific promotion
rollback.procedure: revert only the governance change that introduced the invalid transition; preserve negative receipt
rollback.verification: full Python suite plus focused contract tests must pass with claim_allowed=false

f_ok: repository exposes LICENSE.md and README license reference
packaging metadata is observable in pyproject.toml
module schema already supports PARABOLA and TOKEN_VAZIO epistemic states
anti-regression can be enforced by repository tests
f_next: record license-surface contradiction as an urgency with falsifier
validate typed transformation chain and forbidden promotions
bind external source hashes if/when they are imported into the repository
select canonical machine-readable license metadata only after explicit legal/editorial review
